PHYS 1175 — Physics 2 for Bioscience and Bioengineering | prerequisites, offerings, professors (Northeastern)

NU Map is an independent, student-built planner — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data comes from the public catalog on a schedule; confirm with the official catalog and an advisor. Data updated Aug 2026 · page generated 2026-08-04.

3 semester hoursUndergraduateLectureNUpath NDusually offered: falltypical days: M/WBostonTraditional

Continues PHYS 1171. Includes topics such as wave motion and hearing; electric fields (including application to biological membranes); direct current electrical circuits (including biological circuits); RC circuit models of ion channels; bioelectricity in marine organisms; electromagnetic waves and optics; modern physics (including radioactive decay, applications of radioactivity in nuclear medicine, and carbon 14 dating).
